title: 第021章 想让我低头他们还不够资格第022章 苍云战开始
content_zh:
话语落下，叶龙、叶虎等人猛然蹙眉。
而在这时，一道声音却自大厅之外响起：“让我承认那等之事？云家休想！”
“我父亲之名，谁人敢玷污？”
“若诸位诚心而来，我叶家一定欢迎，若只是如此……那我叶家也只好送客了！”
嗯？
这声音落下，柳芊芊顿时转身，而后看向叶炎，道：“有时候，想要活下去，就必须得低头！”
唯有当众承认这一切，方才能够保命！
那一刻，想必云家也不至于赶尽杀绝吧？
“低头？”
然而柳芊芊话语落下，叶炎却是大笑一声：
“低头？向齐家还是云家？”
“说真的，就凭他们想让我低头，还不够资格！”
闻言，柳芊芊黛眉微蹙：“这种大话，你也说得出口？”
叶炎轻笑，在这世上，人活一口气。
倘若是让父亲死后都要背负如此骂名，让整个叶家的尊严扫地，只为换得自己苟延残喘的一命？
叶炎绝不会答应！
何况，谁说此次苍云战叶家会败？
他叶炎在此，今日苍云战上叶家便会傲然整个苍云城。
“有何不能说，我叶家从未怕过任何人。”这一刻，叶龙也是开口道。
叶虎等人也是神色凛然！

柳芊芊凝眉：“叶家执意如此，那我便也是无话可说。”
“两位，请吧！”叶豹做了一个送客的手势。
“哼！”柳芊芊愤怒无比，随后转身离去。
等到柳家两人离开后，叶龙看向叶炎道：“有你父亲当年的几分气概，齐家乃至云家的确不能让我叶家低头。”
“纵是亡，我叶家也要站着死！”
“叫上叶家的小辈，我们该出发了！”
“是！”大厅内，叶家众人点头。
这一刻，叶龙的神色冷凝到了极致。
随后叶家全部出动，站在了那院落之上。
在这院落中，叶龙看向一旁的叶家祠堂。
那里，一个牌位在列。
content_en:
After the words fell, Ye Long, Ye Hu and others suddenly frowned.
But at this moment, a voice sounded from outside the hall: "You want me to admit such things? The Yun family can't even think about it!"
"Who dares to tarnish my father's name?"
"If you all come sincerely, my Ye family will definitely welcome you. If that's all... then my Ye family will have no choice but to see you off!"
Huh?
When the voice fell, Liu Qianqian immediately turned around, then looked at Ye Yan, and said, "Sometimes, if you want to survive, you have to keep your head down!"
Only by admitting all this in public can we save our lives!
At that moment, surely the Yun family wouldn’t have killed everyone, right?
"Lower your head?"
However, after Liu Qianqian finished speaking, Ye Yan laughed loudly:
"Lower your head? To the Qi family or the Yun family?"
"Seriously, just because they want me to bow down, they are not qualified!"
Hearing this, Liu Qianqian frowned slightly: "Can you say such big words?"
Ye Yan chuckled, in this world, people can only live for one breath.
What if his father had to bear such infamy after his death, and the dignity of the entire Ye family was ruined, just in exchange for his own lingering life?
Ye Yan will never agree!
Besides, who said that Cangyun would lose in this battle with the Ye family?
Ye Yan is here, and if Cangyun fights today, the Ye family will be proud of the entire Cangyun City.
"Why can't I say that my Ye family has never been afraid of anyone." At this moment, Ye Long also said.
Ye Hu and others also looked awe-inspiring!
Liu Qianqian frowned: "If the Ye family insists on doing this, then I have nothing to say."
"You two, please!" Ye Bao made a farewell gesture.
"Humph!" Liu Qianqian was extremely angry, then turned and left.
After the Liu family left, Ye Long looked at Ye Yan and said, "With your father's courage back then, the Qi family and even the Yun family really cannot let my Ye family bow their heads."
"Even if we die, my Ye family will die standing up!"
"Call the juniors from the Ye family, it's time for us to set off!"
"Yes!" Everyone in the Ye family nodded in the hall.
At this moment, Ye Long's expression was extremely condensed.
Then the entire Ye family mobilized and stood in the courtyard.
In this courtyard, Ye Long looked to the side of the Ye family ancestral hall.
There, a tablet is listed.
